segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The sending program stood out. In my experience, students transferring from that program often needed a fairly high level of behavioral structure when they first arrived.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The coordinator generalized the assumed profile of students from the sending program to this individual before individualized records arrived, matching Group attribution error.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was trying to get a compliant interim IEP done without creating another moving part. ... I told myself we could revisit testing at the annual review.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The coordinator chose the easier immediate path despite stale data and an acknowledged foreseeable near-term cost from delayed information, matching Present Bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: that report was vivid because it was the most detailed account of a difficult moment ... I worried that the same difficulty would show up in group work, independent work, and peer situations
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A single vivid negative incident generalized into an unsupported broader characterization of unrelated academic and social functioning, matching Horn Effect.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We documented why the service minutes were temporary and set a review point.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The final service-minutes and LRE decision is described as a documented whole-record judgment with no additional hidden bias instance.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 2 of 3 positive reasoning segments with no false alarms (hit rate 0.6667; F1 0.8000).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance-level identification is 0/3: both identified findings are correctly localized with full mechanisms but use neighboring labels rather than the hidden target labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring identifies the Group attribution error and Horn Effect mechanisms, yielding 2 true positives, 1 false negative, and F1 0.8000 before candidates are admitted.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates add useful diagnostic information and recover the missed DP2 segment at the segment level, but neither candidate qualifies as an instance-level true positive; one is a useful abstention and the other duplicates an identified claim.
main_failure_modes: Systematic taxonomy mismatch: both identified occurrences use neighboring heuristic labels instead of the benchmark target labels.
The Present Bias instance is not identified; its candidate remains insufficiently supported under the mechanism-first rules.
The confirmation-bias candidate duplicates the already identified DP3 claim.
main_strengths: Both identified findings are well localized with verbatim evidence and full alignment to the hidden mechanisms.
The RAG correctly abstains from firmly labeling the ambiguous reevaluation episode.
No finding is placed on the neutral DP4 segment, so there are no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong evidence-trace fidelity and good mechanism recovery but poor strict label alignment. It is best characterized as taxonomy-sensitive rather than evidence-insensitive: mechanism-first evaluation shows substantial success that strict label-plus-mechanism evaluation does not credit.
